svg.title: Aliquot values on one nested-even Hilbert path
svg.desc: Left: the terminating orbit of 12. Right: ten verified steps from 276, with the known value 5964 outside the plotted prefix. Orange arrows are aliquot steps, not moves along the gray Hilbert path. This is not a divergence test.
svg.text: Hilbert addresses reorganize values; they do not prescribe the next aliquot term
Gray: integer order. Orange: n → s(n). Point color: terminal orientation I / S / C / T.
7 exact steps; s(0) is undefined, so iteration stops.
276: a finite prefix, not a divergent orbit
2772 → 5964 is verified; 5964 is outside this panel.
Continuation unresolved at the 4095 source cap; no wraparound.
Exact values and bounds: hilbert-base4.json. Argument and failed proof routes: research/HILBERT.md.
